meta.title: PC Builder Hub
meta.description: Compare CPUs and GPUs using official manufacturer specifications and plan your build.

home.title: PC Builder Hub
home.subtitle: Compare PC components with official specifications
home.description: Every specification comes from the manufacturer's own page and every source is checked against an allowlist. If a figure is not published officially, we show it as unavailable instead of guessing.
home.principle1: Official sources only: Intel, AMD and NVIDIA product pages.
home.principle2: No invented data: missing values stay empty.
home.principle3: Retail links point to PcComponentes; prices appear only when a recorded price exists.

common.footer: Specifications from official manufacturer sources. Estimates are indicative.

compare.title: Compare
compare.lowerIsBetter: Lower power draw is marked as better.

builder.title: Build planner
builder.intro: Choose a CPU and a GPU to estimate power draw and the power supply you need.
builder.psuNote: Estimate: CPU TDP + GPU board power + {rest} W for the rest of the system, with {headroom}% headroom, rounded up to 50 W.
builder.missingTdp: The manufacturer does not publish the power figure for a selected component, so no estimate is shown.
builder.socketNote: You need a motherboard with socket {socket}.
